fields.statement: Verifier at 441ef77d7 re-ran every Checks: command, capped, exit 0 each: go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(daemon-.*|health-projects|inbox-projects|watchdog-health|hook-commands|usage-hold|stage-autonomy)$' (incl. new daemon-status-interventions.txtar: no finished runs gives 0/0/0 with no error in --json and text; live run row intervention_count 2 and ', 2 interventions'; three finished runs intervened/clean/clean by finish time with IDs in reverse order give finished 3, finished_clean 2, clean_streak 2; a newer intervened run resets the streak to 0); describe-golden -update leaves no diff and describe-golden passes; go test ./internal/api -run 'Daemon|Health|Web|ReadOnly|Describe|Schema|Docs'; go vet ./internal/api; rhiza ship generate (0 changed); rhiza render. A scratch multi-project script (root with repo and second, removed afterwards) showed per-project finished 2/1/1 and 1/1/1, a live row intervention_count 1, top-level 0s, and the text lines '  Finished runs: N, M with no interventions, clean streak K' under each project.
